status: VERIFIED_PROVENANCE_AUDIT; manuscript/SI/reviewer response insertion and final QA remain parent-owned
scope: 226 reused cases;1951 accepted candidates;9 recorded families; no upstream model inference or score calibration rerun
main_replacement: For each accepted proposal i, s_i is its stored source-dependent ranking score after any appearance, retrieval, semantic or structural refinement; it is not a common detector likelihood. We set w_i=clip[(0.45+0.55 clip(s_i,0,1)) r_i a_i,0.01,0.995], where r_i is the stored source/profile reliability multiplier and a_i is the optional cross-family agreement factor. The released agreement setting gives a_i=1. Profile priorities can make r_i exceed 1; the bound applies to w_i. A separate broad-scene fallback multiplies the already clipped weight by 0.72 and clips again, although none of the 1,951 benchmark proposals invoked this branch. These fixed transformations shape competing evidence rather than calibrate correctness probabilities. The implementation takes a maximum within each semantic/family cell and a noisy-OR across recorded family cells; dependence between shared model stages remains a limitation.
supplement_provenance: The nine recorded families comprise 226 detector-derived root candidates and 32 retrieved detector candidates;474 detector-derived profile refinements;39 CLIPSeg-SAM2 dense supplements;1067 SAM2 visual proposals;42 appearance contours;53 repetitive details;2 axial residuals;3 axial partitions; and 13 topology proposals. A family label is the explicit metadata grouping key, not necessarily the producing network: profile-dense retains a grounded-family label but its source is CLIPSeg-SAM2, and topology source v2 intentionally retains family v1. Grounding DINO supplies a maximum sigmoid token score; CLIPSeg supplements use the regional maximum of a smoothed sigmoid heatmap; SAM2 visual proposals begin with predicted mask IoU, then may undergo view/crop score scaling. Contour, repetitive, structural and topology scores use the documented deterministic formulas. Every accepted visual/contour proposal is subsequently scored as clip(0.62 s0+0.38 u,0,1); semantic reranking can blend this with an inventory-relative softmax weight. The metadata field sam_quality in visual proposals holds the pre-appearance proposal score, including contour heuristics, so it is not universally a raw SAM prediction. Full producer/transform formulas and source excerpts are in score_source_rules.json.
supplement_ranges: Across the frozen pool, s ranged from 0.0433852337 to 0.9528129163, r from 0.2778563447 to 1.1365760742, a was 1 for all 1951 proposals, and the final effective w ranged from 0.1316655295 to 0.9606005189. Ten reliability multipliers exceeded 1, all in profile refinement. All 1951 score/reliability/agreement/weight records exactly matched the earlier fixed-candidate sensitivity audit. Per-family ranges and exact counts are supplied in score_family_ranges.csv; these are descriptive properties of the stored pool.
reconstruction_and_limits: Retained metadata reproduced 1213 stored score values with no discrepancy above 1e-10. The remaining 738 comprise 732 detector-origin chains whose original logits/pre-retrieval scores were not re-inferred, four cross-source maximum operations whose other precursor score is not retained in the incumbent metadata, and two topology candidates whose anchors are absent from the exported pool. Reliability formulas reproduce 1944/1951 final values. For seven profile-resolved roots, profile_resolution.py retains the geometry root sam_quality but takes the maximum reliability over broad/evidence/geometry roots; the final stored value therefore cannot be recovered from that single q field. These seven simple-formula exceptions are preserved in score_reconstruction_exceptions.csv, and archived final r values are used unchanged. This is a provenance limitation, not permission to substitute inferred reliability. No claim of fresh model-output replication or empirical probability calibration is made.
freezing_audit: The frozen fusion SHA256 matches the handoff and the used prompt-bank SHA256 matches the benchmark manifest. All three used prompt configuration JSON files are semantically and newline-normalized-text identical to the snapshot versions; their raw byte hashes differ because line endings differ, and both are recorded. Source, dependency and input JSON hashes are listed. This verifies the current frozen inputs/rules and preserves them; it does not independently date the original freezing of every model checkpoint.
methods_location: Replace the detector-score definition near the weight equation; put family origins, transformations, observed ranges and reconstruction limits in the score-method SI subsection. Remove any unqualified probability-calibration or independent-source claim.
